◎ INTELLIGENT API CACHE

API Endpoints

All endpoints routed through intelligent cache layer. GET requests are cached with pattern learning.

Base URL: /api/{service}/{endpoint}

Intelligent Caching

All GET requests pass through the cache organism. Responses include cache headers indicating whether the response came from the intelligent cache (HIT) or was freshly computed (MISS).

X-Cache-Organism: HIT | MISS
X-Cache-Age: {milliseconds}
X-Cache-Hits: {count}
X-Organism-Type: {classification}
